# Design a personalised weekly workout plan with Meta AI

**Hook:**
Imagine having a friendly coach in your pocket who asks about your goals, your free days and your favourite activities, then hands you a ready-to-use weekly workout plan in under five minutes. That’s exactly what you’ll be able to do by the end of this guide.

## Before you start
- A **free Meta account** (sign-up takes 2 minutes at meta.com)
- The **Meta AI app** on your phone or the **Meta AI website** on your computer
- About **10 minutes** of your time
- A quiet spot where you can answer a few simple questions

## Step 1 — Open Meta AI and start a new chat
Open the Meta AI app on your phone or go to [meta.ai](https://meta.ai) on your computer. You’ll see a blank chat screen with a blinking cursor at the bottom. Tap or click inside the text box and type your first message. You’ll know it worked when the chat window opens and you can see the blinking cursor ready for your input.
💬 Example:
*Hi*

## Step 2 — Introduce your goal in one sentence
In the chat box, tell Meta AI what you want to achieve. Keep it short and clear so the AI understands your main aim. You’ll know it worked when Meta AI replies with a short summary of your goal and asks a follow-up question.
💬 Example:
*I want a simple weekly workout plan to get stronger and feel more energetic.*

## Step 3 — Share how many days you can train each week
Tell Meta AI how many days you realistically have free for exercise. It’s okay to start small—two or three days is perfect. You’ll know it worked when Meta AI confirms the number and asks what kind of activities you enjoy.
💬 Example:
*I can train 3 days a week.*

## Step 4 — List the activities you like (or want to try)
Type a quick list of exercises or sports you already enjoy or would like to try. Meta AI will use this list to make your plan enjoyable and sustainable. You’ll know it worked when Meta AI repeats your list and asks about any equipment you have at home.
💬 Example:
*I like walking, body-weight squats, push-ups and light yoga.*

## Step 5 — Tell Meta AI about any equipment you own
Mention the gear you have at home—even simple items like a mat, a chair or resistance bands help the AI design a realistic plan. You’ll know it worked when Meta AI confirms your equipment and asks how long each session should be.
💬 Example:
*I have a yoga mat and a chair.*

## Step 6 — Set the length of each workout session
Decide how much time you can dedicate to each session—20, 30 or 45 minutes—and tell Meta AI. You’ll know it worked when Meta AI summarises your preferences and asks if you have any injuries or limitations.
💬 Example:
*Each session should be about 30 minutes.*

## Step 7 — Ask Meta AI to create your weekly plan
Send a short message asking Meta AI to generate your personalised weekly workout plan. You’ll know it worked when Meta AI replies with a clear seven-day schedule that includes the activities you enjoy, the days you chose and the time you set.
💬 Example:
*Please create my weekly workout plan.*

## Common mistakes
- **Listing too many goals at once** — keep it to one main aim so Meta AI doesn’t get confused. Fix: reply with “My main goal is to get stronger.”
- **Forgetting to mention injuries or limitations** — if you skip this, the plan might include moves that don’t suit you. Fix: after Step 6, add “I have a mild knee issue.”
- **Expecting Meta AI to know your exact fitness level** — the AI needs your input to tailor the plan. Fix: be honest about what you can and can’t do.

## What this means for you
- **In everyday life:** You’ll have a ready-to-follow plan that fits your calendar and your preferences, so you’re more likely to stick with it.
- **For your business or work:** If you manage a small team, you can use Meta AI to draft a group wellness plan for colleagues who want to exercise together.
- **If you're just getting started:** Start with two days a week and build up; the plan is yours to adjust anytime.

## Try it now
Open Meta AI, type “I want a simple weekly workout plan to get stronger,” and follow the questions. You’ll have your personalised plan in under five minutes.
